messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from the Tue 03/09 outage postmortem — consolidating action items and owners. I created initial JIRA tickets, please claim and add acceptance criteria.

katie: Thanks. Can you paste the ticket list + proposed due dates here?

sam: Sure — short list: 
- RINF-4892: cache eviction tuning (reduce thrash under bursty workloads). owner: UNASSIGNED. due: 2026-04-02. acceptance: no eviction spikes >30% under synthetic replay for 24h.
- RINF-4893: KV cache metrics + alerting (SLO guardrails). owner: UNASSIGNED. due: 2026-03-26. acceptance: alert fires for sustained >20% miss rate for 15m and dashboard linked.
- RINF-4894: rollout playbook + canary config for ded. pool. owner: UNASSIGNED. due: 2026-03-30. acceptance: staged canary with automatic rollback tested in staging.

sam: RACI (draft): Responsible: implementation = Mohit; Accountable: Sam; Consulted: Esther, Ryan; Informed: eng-sre, eng-platform, customer-success. Please flag if that looks off.

mohit: I can take RINF-4892 (cache tuning). I’ll start with a config sweep and sim replay. milestone: config PR by 2026-03-20, deploy to staging 3/23.

esther: I’ll take RINF-4893 (metrics + alerts) — will add SLO dashboard and link to the ticket. ETA: 2026-03-18 for dashboards, 3/19 for alerting rules.

ryan: I’ll own RINF-4894 (rollout playbook/canary). Will coordinate with Dedicated team for canary gates. ETA: playbook draft 3/22.

sam: Awesome — assigning owners in Jira now. Links: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-4892>, <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-4893>, <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-4894>. Please add watchers: eng-sre, eng-platform, product-risk.

postmortem-bot: PM summary uploaded: https://docs.internal.redwood.com/postmortems/2026-03-09-outage-summary

katie: Two quick asks: 1) add clear acceptance tests to each ticket (so QA knows when to close), 2) add the recurring-incident label if we decide this is a pattern.

mohit: On (1) — adding test vectors and expected eviction graphs to RINF-4892. On (2) — agree it looks recurring (weekly spike on Tue). I’ll add "recurring-incident" and link the last two incidents.

sam: For handoffs — once Mohit has staging validations, Esther will run the post-rollout verification scripts from the PM checklist, then Ryan will execute the canary. Add the handoff checklist to RINF-4894.

esther: I’ll add the verification runbook steps and a small regression test. Also adding a note: include load profile used in replay (so we can reproduce).

ryan: FYI I’ll schedule a 30m sync for next Wed to coordinate canary windows across regions. Invite sent.

katie: Can we set a PI-level owner to track closing these before they age out? suggest: Sam to shepherd across teams, and folks to update tickets weekly.

sam: happy to be PI owner for closure tracking. I’ll run weekly triage and post status in #postmortems every Friday.

mohit: One more technical note — root cause looks like small allocation pattern triggering LRU churn during sudden model-batch spike. Fix will be a combination of increasing TTL for small items + batching limit change. Will document both in RINF-4892.

katie: Great — please include perf numbers after the change. We’ll want regressions covered in the acceptance criteria.

sam: Last ask: when you claim a ticket, update the assignee and set the Jira status to "In Progress". If you need assistance for infra changes, ping @ryan and cc eng-sre.

mohit: Claimed RINF-4892 and updated ETA.

esther: Claimed RINF-4893 and linked dashboard.

ryan: Claimed RINF-4894 and added canary dates.

katie: Thanks everyone. I’ll add these to the postmortem action tracker spreadsheet and set reminders.

sam: Perfect — closing the loop here. If anything slips, please flag in-thread so I can escalate. :thumbsup:
